# Ultramar.capital LLM Context

Canonical domain: https://ultramar.capital
Canonical sitemap: https://ultramar.capital/sitemap.xml
Human-readable sitemap: https://ultramar.capital/sitemap
Legal: https://ultramar.capital/legal
Compliance: https://ultramar.capital/compliance

## Platform

Ultramar.capital is the public home for two Ultramar capital-product lines:

1. Ultramar Private Equities
2. Ultramar Arbitrage Hedge Fund

Capital is the umbrella layer and should not be described as a third public product.

Ultramar Real Estate is a separate land-listing site configuration for
https://realestate.ultramar.capital. It has independent canonical metadata,
discoverability files, and listing-review controls; it is not a third product route
of the capital platform.

The Press section contains market-structure and technical commentary on Uniswap v4 custom accounting, onchain instruments, tokenized private equity, AI compliance, and continuous disclosure. It should not be described as an offering.

Public pages are intentionally concise product surfaces. This file preserves the route-level context agents need without turning the interface into long-form documentation.

## Access Policy

- https://ultramar.capital serves the site directly.
- https://www.ultramar.capital redirects once to https://ultramar.capital.
- https://realestate.ultramar.capital is reserved for an independent Real Estate deployment.
- Prelaunch subdomains, including capital.ultramar.capital, polymarket.ultramar.capital, and private-equities.ultramar.capital, are intentionally not restored, aliased, or redirected.
- API JSON endpoints, auth URLs, controlled portfolio screens, data-room unlock actions, and allocation actions are not public product destinations.

## Product Summaries

Private Equities organizes tokenized private-market access across asset discovery, issuer rounds, oracle-backed operating data, eligible secondary transfer context, compliance boundaries, and investor portfolio visibility. Public materials explain product scope and asset context. Production participation requires eligibility checks, issuer-specific documents, legal review, and transfer controls.

The Arbitrage Hedge Fund is Polymarket-first. It compares prediction-market prices with model or derivatives-implied probabilities, then exposes signal status, confidence, position exposure, dashboard context, sizing controls, liquidity controls, and model-drift risk. Lending markets and derivative-only strategies are research context until data quality, risk limits, and allocator language are complete enough to graduate.

## Research Pages

Polymarket arbitrage explainer:
https://ultramar.capital/research/polymarket-arbitrage-explainer
Explains why prediction-market prices can diverge from derivatives-implied probability models and why spreads need explicit comparison models and risk controls.

Tokenized private equity primer:
https://ultramar.capital/research/tokenized-private-equity-primer
Explains that tokenized private equity requires issuer onboarding, legal wrappers, eligibility, data, custody, and transfer controls before tokens are useful.

Issuer oracle memo:
https://ultramar.capital/research/issuer-oracle-operating-data
Explains why issuer operating data, solvency context, liquidity state, and data recency matter for private-market trust.

Event-market risk controls memo:
https://ultramar.capital/research/event-market-risk-controls
Explains sizing, liquidity, exposure, resolution, and model-drift controls for event-market arbitrage.

## Press Pages

Capital Windows: Gated company-token conversion with Uniswap v4 custom accounting:
https://ultramar.capital/press/capital-windows-uniswap-v4-custom-accounting
Explains the Uniswap v4 hackathon implementation for gated primary conversion and company-sponsored secondary liquidity windows using custom accounting, signed authorization, investor caps, oracle freshness, and exact-input routing.

Why capital markets need onchain instruments now:
https://ultramar.capital/press/why-capital-markets-need-onchain-instruments-now
Explains why onchain instruments are an operating response to private-market opacity, high secondary fees, slow settlement, and unequal access.

Private secondaries need transparent rails:
https://ultramar.capital/press/private-secondaries-need-transparent-rails
Explains why private secondary markets need better ownership records, transfer controls, price confidence, and issuer state rather than more manual toll booths.

AI compliance is the disclosure layer tokenized equity is missing:
https://ultramar.capital/press/ai-compliance-is-the-disclosure-layer-for-tokenized-equity
Explains how source-bound financial data, anomaly detection, and explainable compliance scores can support tokenized equity.

Retail access to private companies should not wait for the IPO:
https://ultramar.capital/press/retail-access-to-private-companies-should-not-wait-for-ipo
Explains the access thesis for controlled private-company investing before traditional public listings.

## Compliance And Non-Offer Boundaries

- Ultramar.capital materials are informational.
- Public materials do not provide legal, tax, accounting, or investment advice.
- Public materials do not collect funds, provide subscription instructions, or create binding commitments.
- Private-market participation can require KYC, KYB where relevant, investor category checks, suitability checks, jurisdiction review, issuer documents, transfer restrictions, custody controls, and counsel approval.
- Projected returns, yields, timelines, market conditions, and operating milestones are illustrative unless finalized in controlled documents.
- Non-public financials, subscription instructions, funds-flow details, allocation decisions, and investor-only Q&A belong behind permissioned access.
